excerpt: Local-first, vendor-neutral, cost-aware. Not the next LangChain: ~1k LOC core you can read in an afternoon. config.yaml → llm/factory → agent/loop → tools/registry (+ RAG as tool, MCP tools) 0.1.0 Feedback Welcome: This is an early release focused on clean primitives, explicit routing, and readable internals rather than heavyweight abstractions. If you spot rough edges in the async loop, MCP lifecycle, routing/cache semantics, or API ergonomics, please open an issue or start a thread in Discussions. import asyncio from llm_harness_lite import Agent, ToolRegistry, create_llm, tool registry = ToolRegistry() @tool(registry) def add_numbers(a: int, b: int) -> int: """Add two integers together.""" return a + b async def main() -> None: llm = create_llm("openai_compat", "qwen3:8b", base_url=" async with llm: agent = Agent(llm=llm, registry=registry) result = await agent.arun("What is 17 + 25?") print(result.answer, result.stop_reason, result.usage) asyncio.run(main()) See examples/ (01_basic_chat.py through 07_document_inquirer.py) and LOCAL_SETUP.md for full workflows covering RAG, MCP, caching, and cost comparisons. pip install llm-harness-lite # dependency-free core pip install "llm-harness-lite[openai]" # OpenAI-compatible providers pip install "llm-harness-lite[anthropic]" # Anthropic pip install "llm-harness-lite[pgvector]" # PostgreSQL + pgvector RAG pip install "llm-harness-lite[qdrant]" # Qdrant RAG pip install "llm-harness-lite[mcp]" # MCP client pip install "llm-harness-lite[full]" # all integrations + example config deps # or local dev: # python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate # pip install -e ".[dev,examples,openai,ollama,pgvector]" # docker compose up -d db The core package uses only the Python standard library. Provider SDKs, vector database clients, and the MCP SDK are optional; install only the extras your application uses. OpenAI-compatible providers (including Ollama and vLLM) use the openai extra. The package requires Python 3.10 or newer…
